title: EU's €45B Ukraine Loan Explained in 60 Seconds
description:
The European Commission proposed a €45B loan for Ukraine's 2027 needs: up to €25B military, up to €20B budget. Ukraine repays only once Russia pays reparations. EU countries still have to approve it.
